description: The Institute of Statistics of Albania publishes its census tables as spreadsheets on one page for the 2023 and 2011 Population and Housing Censuses. The 2023 housing tables count conventional dwellings by occupancy, type of building and dwellings per building; inhabited dwellings, households and population by type of housing, water supply (piped inside the dwelling, inside the building, outside the building, other or none) and type of toilet; and dwellings by floor space, period of construction and occupants. The 2023 total is 726,733 inhabited dwellings with 2,385,854 residents. The 2011 tables add residential buildings by type, floors and period of construction, households by main type of heating and energy used for heating, amenities and tenure, many split by prefecture. Headings are in Albanian and English. Format and access: free XLSX and XLS downloads, plus a PX-Web database for 2023. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the 2023 housing tables read are national totals, the database host reset the connection from the cloud, and the 2011 and 2023 tables differ in layout. Simulation uses: water and sanitation service levels, heating energy and building age for exposure and energy models. Related records: IPUMS International and the EU building stock observatory.
